text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day following the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Tokai Teio requested to train,
even though it was the day right after a race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you know? They say the Kikuka Sho
is won by the 'strongest horse girl'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna surpass the Prez, I've gotta earn the title of "Strongest Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, let's get right into today's
pace-running training!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, totally fine!
I'm the invincible Tokai Teio, remember?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, no matter what happens, the Kikuka Sho
won't wait for us. There's no time to rest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the tandem running training
was set to continue.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Further, and further ahead!
Yaaaaaaaah~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew... Great job, Teio-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good work today! Thanks for pacing with me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to be able to run like that...
Isn't she already the number one in the Classic class?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but my goal is the Prez, after all!
I've gotta get waaay faster!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Tokai Teio continued
to do tandem training with numerous Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... What incredible running, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"It was fierce, or rather...
I could just feel her sheer desperation."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. If I don't work at least this hard, I won't get anywhere near my goal—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch!! Ow-ow-ow...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio collapsed to the ground
with an expression of sheer agony...!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
This isn't an injury from
just yesterday or today's training...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"It's more like everything that's been building up for a while
has finally started to show on the surface."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, even with your legs in tatters,
you kept on running, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...By the time the Derby was over,
there was already pain in my legs."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, I thought if I stopped training here,
I wouldn't be able to win the Kikuka Sho...
choice_data_list: You were training through the pain...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
...It is difficult to say, but in her current state,
the Kikuka Sho may prove to be too much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? N-No way...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: No training for a while, then.
No training for a while, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way!!
I don't have time to rest!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure, my legs hurt, but...
Still, something like that's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep up my training!
I'm definitely running in the Kikuka Sho, no matter what!
choice_data_list: Didn't they tell you the Kikuka Sho would be difficult?
They told you the Kikuka Sho would be tough, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh... St-Still, I'm gonna run!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to get real results!
To prove that I'm an Umamusume worthy of challenging the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If you're telling me no, I'll run on my own!
You don't even have to watch me anymore, Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no matter what kind of scary face you make, Trainer,
I'm gonna run! I'm definitely gonna run!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez told me herself!
She said, "I'm glad you've come to the same stage"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez is waiting for me! That's why
I can't stop here, no way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With tears welling up in her eyes,
Tokai Teio looked this way with a resolute gaze that said she'd never give up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I've always looked up to the Prezy!
Even before I entered the academy, and right now! And forever into the future, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So no matter how amazing the Prez is,
I won't give up. Never, ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her strong feelings toward her dream
will never break, no matter what hardships she faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Trainer of such a strong Umamusume,
can I really just give up so easily under these circumstances...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Trainer?
What's up? Why'd you suddenly start reading a book?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Acupuncture," "massage," whatever it takes—
just do something—
choice_data_list: I'll find a way for you to run with everything you've got!
I'll find a way for you to run at your full potential!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then... is it okay for me to run?
Can I really aim for the Kikuka Sho!?
choice_data_list: Supporting their Umamusume is what a Trainer does.
Supporting their Umamusume is what a Trainer does.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah!
Ehehe... Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And also... I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not just keeping my injury a secret...
I said some awful things earlier, too...
About running on my own...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I promise we'll do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, I'll help search for a way to heal injuries too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Look, look, it says "hot spring cure"!
I wanna go to a hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a result of focusing on leg care for a while after that, she managed to avoid any serious issues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Heading toward the 'Kikuka Sho',
the third leg of the Classic races, their challenge together begins!"
